verdict.rationale: BILL's own marketing claims its cards make 'every transaction controlled, categorized, and automatically compliant', and its API docs cover setting up budgets and virtual cards, which loosely implies spend limits. Nothing documents restrictions by category, merchant, or amount, or declining out-of-policy transactions at the point of sale. Missing for 10: documented merchant/category (MCC) card restrictions, per-card or per-transaction amount limits, explicit point-of-sale decline/auto-lock behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
